summary: v10.2.22 symmetric 4H trend-filter slope relaxation validated (25/25 PASS). Covered: (1) Unit _trend_down_streak: rises 1->2->3 on consecutive trending_down, resets to 0 on any other regime, first-after-other=1, capped at 99. (2) Unit _trend_up_streak regression (v10.2.17 behavior intact). (3) _get_btc_regime persistence: trend_down_streak accumulates 1->2->3 in asi_scan_status.btc_regime doc, resets to 0 on regime change, trend_up_streak still tracked, latch path (bearish_reversal) carries trend_down_streak field. (4) Scanner integration (FakeDB + signal_fetcher stub + monkeypatched market_data.get_crypto_snapshot/execute_trade/resolve_credential/_get_btc_regime): LONG with price>EMA50 & slope_dn passes trend-filter when regime=trending_up & trend_up_streak>=3 (proceeds to 2-cycle confirm then executes); rejected 'trend_filter_4h_blokir_LONG' when streak=0 (neutral/unconfirmed). SHORT with price<EMA50 & slope_up passes when regime=trending_down & trend_down_streak>=3; rejected 'trend_filter_4h_blokir_SHORT' when streak=0. BIAS NEVER RELAXED: LONG with price<EMA50 rejected even at streak=20; SHORT with price>EMA50 rejected even at dn_streak=20. (5) Scanner doc + GET /api/asi/scan-debug?device_id=hc expose btc_trend_down_streak and buy_gates.trend4h_slope_relax_on_confirmed_btc=true (verified live: regime=trending_up, up_streak=21, dn_streak=0, flag=true). (6) Regressions: iter50 v10.2.21 suite 25 PASS + anti-flap/bear4h/2-cycle-confirm gates re-verified inside iter51; iter49 v10.2.20 lossless fills 12 PASS. iter47 has the same 3 known expected failures documented in iteration_50.json (superseded by v10.2.21) — unchanged. EMA slope/bias test series verified numerically against indicators._ema before use. No real Binance orders placed.

Bias condition is outside the relaxation in both directions — matches the v10.2.22 spec exactly.

Note: during an active reversal latch the streaks keep tracking the FRESH regime (not the latched one); this matches v10.2.17 semantics and is intentional, but worth documenting since a 120-min latch with fresh regime flipping will reset streaks even though the effective gate regime stays latched.

rca_of_issue: Root cause of the user-reported bug (3 days of SHORT-only executions despite BTC V-reversal): the per-coin 4H trend-filter added 15/10 required BOTH price>EMA50 AND non-falling EMA50 slope for LONG. EMA50 on 4H has ~200h memory, so its slope keeps falling for 1-2 days after a dump even when price has reclaimed EMA50 and BTC is trending_up — rejecting every LONG. Fix v10.2.22 (option 1, user-approved): when BTC regime stays trending_up for >=TREND_UP_MIN_CYCLES(3) scanner cycles, the slope condition for LONG is relaxed (price>EMA50 alone suffices); symmetric relaxation for SHORT via the new _trend_down_streak tracker persisted in asi_scan_status.btc_regime. The price-vs-EMA50 bias condition is never relaxed, and full slope protection remains active when BTC is unconfirmed (neutral/streak<3) — preserving the 15/10 bounce-trap protection. Mitigation verified by 25 new tests + 37 regression tests; no real exchange orders during testing.
